AW-STUDY-0040

Texture Studio

Pick a hero on the left and a look along the bottom. The look repaints every named part (skin, cloth, metal, lights, glass), presses its surface into the bump, and picks the light. Paint on the body with the brush, or fill a whole part.

The four looks

    How it works

    • The heroes are the Meshy brutes from the Bruiser study, cleaned up, painted and rigged for Brute Fight (20 bones, 19 moves). The Moon gear kit bolts onto the same bones.
    • The old paint is split into shading (the sculpt, the creases, the eyebrows) and colour. The shading stays; each look brings its own colours and surface.
    • Surfaces are drawn in the flat texture (the UV card shows it): thumbprints, a knitted vest, felt, wood grain, brush strokes. The same pattern becomes the bump, so light catches it.
    • The light comes from our shader kit: Sunday Toon, Clay (the cheap half of the Storybook look), Ink, Film and Painted Brush (Arcane-inspired).
    • The looks are data in looks.json: any rigged character with parts named Skin, TankTop, Shorts, Armor, Light and Glass can wear them, including the wooden mannequin once it is rigged.
